_comment: Box screener rows for /best-hobby-boxes-2026 (spec claude/handoffs/box-screener-2026-10-20.md §3A). One row per product × format. sold = SportsCardsPro single-box sold median (read rule: 30 d, widen to 60 then 90 d below 5 sales; post-street-date only; jumbo, case, lot, break excluded). eBay is a buy link only, never a mark. Config fields (packs, cardsPerPack, hits, msrp, variety) only from a cited source; null otherwise. Note tokens {IDX.median} {IDX.n} {IDX.top} {IDX.topPrice} {IDX.k} {IDX.mark} {ROW.perHit} are filled by tools/build-box-screener.mjs from data/indices.json. Edit here, then run the generator; never hand-edit the BOXSCREENER / BOXNOTES blocks.
readRule: single-box hobby (or jumbo) sales on SportsCardsPro in the 30 days to the read date; under 5 sales, widen to 60 then 90 days; sales before street date, cases, lots, breaks, packs and other products excluded by title

msrp.source: Checklist Insider (presale $239.99, $259.99 on release day); KB bowman 04 §5 / GAPS G13

rows.keepLine: 2026 Bowman Baseball is the best prospect box of the year and it's not particularly close.
rows.ebayQuery: Sealed Hobby Box Bowman Baseball 2026 -chrome -sapphire -draft -"best of" -mega -case -pack -packs -jumbo -blaster -lot
rows.note:
2026 Bowman Baseball is the best prospect box of the year and it's not particularly close. It came out May 13, 2026 at $239.99 on presale ($259.99 on release day, per Checklist Insider) with one auto per box. The checklist has 150 Chrome Prospects and 87 signed versions, and 76 of those are 1st Bowman autos (per Checklist Insider). Ethan Holliday's 1st Bowman Chrome, BCP-1, is in this set.

One auto at a $377.50 box means your auto has to be worth about $380 to break even. On our {BB26.mark} BB26 mark, the median 2026 Bowman (May) 1st auto was {BB26.median}, and {BB26.k} of the {BB26.n} we track reached {ROW.perHit}. The top one was {BB26.top} at {BB26.topPrice}. So a box comes out ahead on a numbered parallel or a top name. A jumbo sold for a $659.00 median (5 sales, Aug 14–Sep 26) with three autos.

msrp.source: Checklist Insider (presale $519.99, $539.99 on release day); KB bowman GAPS G13
Checklist Insider (presale $299.99 Aug 10, $329.99 on release day); KB bowman 02 §1 [HIGH]

rows.note:
2026 Bowman Chrome came out Sep 9, 2026. A hobby box is 6 packs of 10 with 2 on-card autos, and it was $329.99 at release. It's a different set from May's 2026 Bowman. The 1st class here is mostly the 2026 international signings, and the checklist has 104 Chrome Prospect Autographs, 97 of them 1st Bowman autos. See the 2026 Bowman Chrome guide and the BCB26 index.

At the $509.99 median, each auto costs about $255. On our {BCB26.mark} BCB26 mark, {BCB26.k} of the {BCB26.n} base 1st autos had a 30-day median that high. The top one was {BCB26.top} at {BCB26.topPrice}, so a box comes out ahead on the parallels and the rare big hit.

Jumbos sold for $245.00 (8 sales, Sep 15–Oct 16). See the 2026 Topps Series 2 guide.

profiles.method: For each figure, the boxes that have it are ranked from worst to best. A box is scored on a goal only when every figure that goal weighs is on file and it passes the goal's gate; the score (0 to 100) is the weighted average of its ranks. Best fit is the highest-scoring of Prospector, Collector and Ripper. Budget and Set builder are the badge only when none of those three applies, and a box with no goal reads "Needs data".

list.name: Prospector
list.gate: carries 1st Bowman autos, with the count on file

list.name: Collector
list.goal: lots of different looks from one box
list.gate: parallel and insert count on file

list.name: Set builder
list.gate: $ per card in the cheapest third of the boxes here

list.name: Ripper
list.goal: the big pull at the top of the set
list.gate: set indexed on 20+ priced cards, and lottery ratio 3 or more or top card 25% or more of the set

list.name: Budget
list.goal: a guaranteed hit for the least money
list.gate: box price in the cheapest third of the boxes here, or $200 or less

list.name: Sealed holder
list.note: Needs three months of box sales. No box here has that yet, so this profile scores nothing and gives no badge.

metrics.firstAutosPerBox: 1st Bowman autos per box (autos per box × the checklist's share of 1st autos; 0 for non-Bowman products)
metrics.firstAutoMedOverPerHit: median 1st auto in our index ÷ $ per hit
metrics.skew: skew of the index's hit prices
metrics.variety: parallels and inserts in an average box (Checklist Insider or Cardsmiths Breaks box guides; each row names its source)
metrics.baseShare: base cards' share of set value (Pokémon whole-set indices only)
metrics.topShare: top card's share of the index
metrics.msrpHistory: sold history against MSRP (3 months or more)

profiles._tuning: v2 (Box Desk rev 2 after CoS review, rebuilt Oct 22): full-coverage rule + printed gates (gate logic in the generator, GATES). Index-only figures (median 1st auto ÷ $/hit, skew) left Prospector and base share left Set builder so a missing index cannot lock a box out; they stay as table columns.
